q: Our EU importer wants CBAM data for every shipment. Is that really needed?
title: CBAM data per shipment or per period
short: Embedded emissions are worked out per installation and product over a reporting period, not shipment by shipment. Your importer may still ask you to tag each shipment with the period's figure, CN code and installation, so their declaration adds up. Agree a format once.
audience: Exporters fielding repeated CBAM requests from EU importers

ul: Installation where the goods were made.
The specific embedded emissions per tonne, which come from the period's monitoring.

p: Send one data sheet per period and quote its reference on each invoice.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

links.label: Share data with many buyers once
